pr_title: sql: do not auto-commit inside planner if DDL is executed
pr_body:
Previously, we had an optimization that allowed the planner to auto-commit after operations like insert, etc.. This was normally fine, but if we executed any DDL, then during commit processing we may need to do additional work. So, letting DML commit the transaction isn't safe. To address this, this patch will disable auto-commit inside the planner if we executed any DDL statements earlier.

Fixes: #93010

Release note (bug fix): In Postgres extended protocol mode it was possible for auto-commits to not execute certain logic for DDL, when certain DML (insert/update/delete) and DDL were combined in an implicit transaction.

issue_context.title: schema: multi-region costfuzz and UQO tests frequently hang in the presence of a stuck DDL DROP
issue_context.body:
Examples:

- #90683
- #92753

Simply re-enabling DDL in newMutatingSmither should be enough to re-create.    This also happened back when these tests where 4 nodes but the problem was only ever seen with the seed-multi-region variants.

Its not clear yet if the DDL hang causes the tests to timeout or is just coincident.  There may be more than one bug here but this issue is purely about the DDL DROP hang, we plan to disable DDL and see how that affects the tests, hopefully in the future we can re-enable it, maybe in a meta-morphic fashion.

Jira issue: CRDB-22105
comments: This also corresponds with the tests that are failing, which use seed-multi-region setup, will investigate this much deeper tomorrow. But there is a clear correlation here, something is not handled transactionally correctly for this sequence.
Reopening to not forget about backport.
Closing now that the backport is merged

review_comments: Yes, this was always incrementing for ever before :(
